name: 钉钉 AI 助理
desc: Buying a dedicated AI tool for one workflow means a separate login, a separate bill, and n
desc_zh: 为某一条工作流单独买一个 AI 工具，意味着另一套账号、另一笔费用，而且碰不到它真正需要的工作数据。AI 助理长在钉钉里，能直接取到钉钉内的数据。
solves: Buying a dedicated AI tool for one workflow means a separate login, a separate bill, and no access to the work data it would need. AI assistants live inside DingTalk and reach its own data.
solves_zh: 为某一条工作流单独买一个 AI 工具，意味着另一套账号、另一笔费用，而且碰不到它真正需要的工作数据。AI 助理长在钉钉里，能直接取到钉钉内的数据。
best_for: A team that already runs on DingTalk and wants an assistant grounded in its own approvals, chats, and docs.
best_for_zh: 已经在用钉钉的团队，想要一个能读到自己审批、消息和文档的助手。
notes: 集成在 钉钉 内的能力。来源：https://open.dingtalk.com/document/assistants-overview
